name: WebEngine MetaModule Catalog Consumer
purpose: validate and consume the DWH MetaModule browse/coverage projection without creating canonical identity or registry authority in the browser
rules: catalog data is immutable runtime projection state
BusinessSuite, Strategy and Everyday grouping entries must remain NOT_EVENT_OWNER
display labels and unresolved entries remain unresolved in WebEngine
WebEngine must not mint or normalize canonical MetaModule IDs
catalog resolution failure is visible and has no hard-coded fallback catalog
mmdemo synthetic data is consumer/demo data and never canonical evidence
